channel.title: Institute for Migrant Rights: what’s new in the databases
channel.description: Monthly update on new court decisions and laws in the IMR databases.

item.title: What’s new in the databases: November 2026
item.description: 1,014 court decisions added to Court Decisions (11 full entries with a summary, 1,003 unchecked candidates).1 earlier entry moved up a step in checking.86 laws, regulations and instruments added to the lists of legal texts.15 new or updated files of material received for review (not yet in the databases).
